definitions.explanation: The highest form of happiness or joy. A state of complete, perfect satisfaction.

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}に{浸|つ}かって{至福|しふく}の{時間|じかん}を{過|す}ごした。
examples.english: I spent a blissful time soaking in a hot spring.

examples.japanese: {焼|や}きたてのパンを{頬張|ほおば}る{瞬間|しゅんかん}は、まさに{至福|しふく}だ。
examples.english: The moment you bite into freshly baked bread is pure bliss.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {至|し} (utmost, supreme) and {福|ふく} (happiness, good fortune). Often used in the set phrase {至福|しふく}のひととき (a blissful moment) or {至福|しふく}の{時間|じかん} (blissful time). Common in writing about food, relaxation, and luxury experiences.

NOTE: Not to be confused with the homophone {私服|しふく} (plain clothes, casual wear).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {至福|しふく}のひととき (a blissful moment)
- {至福|しふく}の{時間|じかん} (blissful time)
- {至福|しふく}を{味|あじ}わう (to savor bliss)
- {至福|しふく}に{満|み}ちた (filled with bliss)
